preset_description: EXPERIMENTAL. 40 Hz gamma binaural beat (400/440 Hz carriers) for short focus sessions. Context: 40 Hz light flicker and click trains reduced amyloid in mice (Iaccarino et al. 2016; Murdock et al. 2024), and human 40 Hz trials used combined light and sound devices, not binaural beats (Chan et al. 2022). Evidence for 40 Hz binaural beats specifically is weak: a randomised trial found no working-memory benefit at 40 Hz (Rakhshan et al. 2022), and studies have not shown reliable 40 Hz EEG entrainment from binaural beats (Engelbregt et al. 2021). Binaural beats are perceived most clearly below about 30 Hz. For the pulsed 40 Hz sound the studies used, try the Gamma 40 Hz Pulses preset. Use for short sessions (15 min) at low volume. Stop if headaches or discomfort occur. NOT recommended for ADHD - try 10 Hz Alpha or 14 Hz SMR instead. REQUIRES HEADPHONES. Individual response varies significantly.
